newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Li updates Oriental Plaza share distribution.
newsitem.headline: HK's Li updates Oriental Plaza share distribution.

text.p: Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd and Hutchison Whampoa Ltd keep a stake of over 50 percent in the US$2 billion Oriental Plaza development in Beijing, the companies' chairman Li Ka-shing said on Thursday.
That is after a "big and strong" Chinese-funded company has taken a 20 percent stake in the development, he told reporters
Li did not name the Chinese concern but the People's Insurance Co of China is already known to be a shareholder of the project.
Last October, Orient Overseas (International) Ltd, another partner in the development, said the Chinese insurer had taken a 15 percent interest in the project.
Li said on Thursday Orient Overseas' shareholding in the project might now be less than 20 percent.
The project is still waiting for formal approval documents before construction can start, Li said.
He had said earlier this month he hoped to be able to receive the approval documents by July 1.
Oriental Plaza is a development of hotel, residential and retail spaces. It will include an exhibition hall to house archaeological findings at the site in the Chinese capital.
